answer: Agents burn 0.18 lumens of opal luminescence trapped in a timed lantern vault; at epoch end the vault opens only if the lantern’s flicker syncs to a 940ms echo from a sapphire pinhole. A Sybil must relight each lantern, costing 0.18 lumens of unforgeable decay per head—bulk lumps of opal cannot refill the lost spectra in parallel.
